proof_availability.classification_scope: Under a fixed finite-dimensional exact-rational linear interface exposing vector and transpose actions for A and B, a declared bounded word/rank/degree search can acquire a law AB=q BA+cI+UV^T plus its low-rank defect, or a small faithful operator algebra. Fresh exact-vector checks give a randomized all-input identity certificate with a stated false-accept bound. Conditional on that accepted event, retained defect factors and degree-filtered modules give exact corrections and validity domains for later bounded-degree programs without further native acquisition calls; checked finite closure instead represents all finite polynomial circuits in the same primitives. Failure of the declared budgets or a non-unique candidate remains UNKNOWN. Full coefficient rank excludes a rank-one law only in the tested quadratic library. These are computational source results, not acquired physical laws.
